name: e4-hybrid-gateway
description: E4: Go AI gateway policies in front of a self-hosted fleet (real llm-d EPP over 4 inference-sim workers, ~16 concurrent slots) with overflow to Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite under the shared $10 cap. local_only vs local_first (overflow beyond 12 in flight) vs remote_only, swept over concurrency. Local latencies are simulated (calibrated to E1/E2); Gemini latency and spend are real.
